newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JUNE 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JUNE 19.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin is to deliver a keynote policy speech to National Assembly from 1300 GMT this afternoon. He is seen facing a difficult financial situation, as social security deficit may reach 40 to 50 billion francs for 1997 according to some estimates.
-- Appliance manufacturer Moulinex posts its first profit in five years, a 29 million francs profit for the year to end March.
-- Restructuring plan at Electrolux begins to be implemented in Reims, France plant.
-- Rhone Poulenc to concentrate on specialty chemical activities, sell assets in basic chemistry.

-- Alcatel Alsthom and Lagardere still eager to take part in a restructuring of the defence industry, despite doubt about a quick privatisation of Thomson-CSF. Aerospatiale is said not to rule out taking part in an Alcatel satellites project.
-- Thomson-CSF and Thomson Multimedia to join forces to manufacture high-technology plasma screens.
